title: Safety‑Belt Bisection Controller for Private Data‑Plane Upgrades
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a new upgrade orchestration pattern for private (VPC) data‑plane/runtime rollouts that minimizes blast radius while guaranteeing zero‑downtime for tenant traffic. The 'Safety‑Belt Bisection Controller' will use deterministic tenant set bisection, progressive health scoring, and emergency safety‑belt eviction to perform upgrades and enable fast, reliable rollbacks without traffic loss or cache corruption.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Upgrades proceed by repeated bisection of tenant slices with automated health scoring. 2) No 5xx customer requests during canary and staged rollout phases in controlled testbed. 3) Automated rollback completes and returns traffic to previously healthy instances within configured SLOs (default 2 minutes). 4) KV cache and session priming validation runs successfully after each stage. 5) Terraform plan/apply hooks validate no destructive infra changes prior to traffic shift.
technical_notes: Controller operates as an operator triggered by Terraform post‑apply hook. Works with per‑tenant routing metadata and a tenant registry. Health scoring aggregates: synthetic probe pass rate, tail latency (p95/p99), error budget burn, and KV cache miss spike. Bisection partitions tenants into power‑of‑two slices to minimize blast radius while maintaining utilization. Safety‑belt eviction pauses rollout and triggers rollback if scoring threshold crossed. State persisted in customer VPC control plane database (encrypted) and can be scrubbed for air‑gapped installs.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Preflight (terraform plan validation, schema checks, snapshot KV caches). Phase 1: Dry run on staging shards using traffic replay. Phase 2: Slice bisection canary: 1/8 tenants, synthetic probes + live traffic shadowing. Phase 3: Progressive bisection doubling slices (1/8 -> 1/4 -> 1/2 -> full) with health gating at each step. Phase 4: Post‑rollout consistency sweep to reconcile KV cache and session stores. Default gate: >=99.9% synthetic pass and p99 latency within 1.3x baseline.
rollback_playbook: Trigger conditions: 1) Safety‑belt threshold breach (configurable), 2) operator manual abort. Steps: A) Immediately stop traffic to new cohort via router tag revert. B) Initiate hot rollback: promote previous runtime variant and rehydrate KV cache snapshot from last known good checkpoint. C) Run prioritized synthetic probes and a targeted session reconnection test. D) Run post‑rollback integrity checks and alert on anomalies. E) If rollback fails, initiate containment: divert affected tenant traffic to Hosted fallback (if enabled) and open incident. Playbook includes automated PR creation for infra drift and one‑click runbook links.
testing_plan: Unit tests for bisection math and gating logic. Integration tests in staging with traffic-replay harness (ENG testbed). Chaos tests: network partition, node eviction, KV cache thrash. Canary metrics: traffic error rate, request latency, token generation tail latency, KV miss rate. Run one end‑to‑end dry run with a subset of internal tenants and verify zero customer‑visible errors for 48 hours.
